_comment: Only site-specific knowledge lives here; scripts/** stay URL-agnostic.
_captureMode: Set to 'static' as a HYPOTHESIS carried over from the previous run's memory note,
which recorded that the pre-JS response already contains all real content while
rendering only ADDED client-side nav chrome. Must be re-proved with a jsdom probe
against THIS run's capture before it is trusted (prior-run notes are hypotheses,
not evidence). Check codegen's printed element AND asset ratios too.
_settleMs: ms to wait after load before capturing (raise for slow hero animations)
_scrollSettleMs: ms to pause at each scroll step (raise for lazy-loading sites)
_links: 'absolute' rewrites every nav link to the live site; 'preserve' keeps them as-is
_viewports: Default breakpoint set; intuit.com's own nav breakpoint (1120px) is handled in an effect, not here.
